verdict.summary: The projected-CRS gate remains fail-closed while correctly admitting definitions whose WKT axis directions match proj4rs's source-axis convention. The new parser validates the complete three-character +axis value before comparing its first two directions, defaults consistently to enu, and rejects missing WKT axes, transposed axes, malformed values, and WKT/PROJ.4 disagreements. The focused tests exercise both refusal paths and real transformations for wsu across WGS84-coincident and datum-shifted definitions, with independent same-projection UTM witnesses; they also cover the registry-wide explicitly tagged set and the swu admission/non-evaluable distinction. Documentation is updated consistently. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was present in the diff.
